definitions.week_start: Monday of the week the notice was published in The Gazette (not the date of the insolvency itself).
definitions.region: From the map point The Gazette attaches to each notice, matched to the nearest postcode (postcodes.io, ONS data). 'Unknown' where the notice has no map point or none within 2km.
definitions.headline_insolvencies: Administration + receiverships + creditors' voluntary liquidation + winding-up orders. Petitions and disclaimers are reported separately; members' voluntary liquidations (solvent) are excluded.
definitions.covid_restrictions: Winding-up petitions were restricted by law from 27 April 2020 to 31 March 2022 (Corporate Insolvency and Governance Act 2020 and follow-on regulations). Petition and winding-up order numbers in that period are artificially low.

sources: The Gazette (thegazette.co.uk), Open Government Licence; notice counts only, no personal data reused
postcodes.io (ONS Postcode Directory), Open Government Licence
